verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at increase.com/llms.txt and a markdown documentation index (documentation.md) that links to .md versions of each doc page. The cited doc pages are all served as .md URLs, and a machine-readable openapi.json is also published, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: no first-party guidance on using the docs with agents (e.g., an llms-full.txt or agent-usage page) and no independent or community corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
